title: Fix every typo in the recipe
brief: The word 'suger' is misspelled three times in this cookie recipe. Fix all occurrences to 'sugar' using search and repeat.
text:
Chocolate Chip Cookies
1 cup suger
1/2 cup brown suger
2 cups flour
Sprinkle extra suger on top
Bake at 350F for 12 min.

expect.text:
Chocolate Chip Cookies
1 cup sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
2 cups flour
Sprinkle extra sugar on top
Bake at 350F for 12 min.

why: After changing the first match with cw, pressing n jumps to the next match and dot repeats the change. This avoids typing a global substitute command for quick fixes.
author: claude (daily)
hint: Find the first one, fix it, then use n to find the next and . to repeat the edit.
